# proftpd / fuzzer

proftpd's own fuzz target `fuzzer` ([source](source/json_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over proftpd (proftpd/proftpd at a8a98dc5).

NUL-terminates the input and calls pr_json_object_from_text on it, then on four fixed strings (trailing comma, 4 keys, 4-deep nesting, invalid UTF-8); every returned object is freed unexamined.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against proftpd at commit a8a98dc5.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch proftpd` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzzer.plain` | 258,392 | `06f84eb8dfe9b2284388670a39242fa5e8fd92a78e70348be73e97e2575f69cd` |
| ubsan | `fuzzer.ubsan` | 277,504 | `b38fd2bba9540685206e29f4910880d7003ae5d41401b41b940ecf08e141edb2` |
| asan | `fuzzer.asan` | 1,046,808 | `602278ccaa6d85403a83e04629ab2b8c86740249db69bf9d3a7e7016ed0cd9a8` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,064,856 | `6efabff2d37e820186edbdacd89410f1a41e046b4a78dd082703d9e822827382` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
